verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a built-in AI Assistant in the Connector Builder UI that automatically prefills and configures connector fields and sections, so users can hand off part of connector setup. That assistant is scoped to connector development rather than general task delegation across the product. The Airbyte Agents/MCP material is about external agents connecting to Airbyte, not an in-product assistant, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: an assistant that takes delegated tasks beyond connector setup (e.g. managing connections, syncs or troubleshooting), depth on what the assistant can do end to end, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI Assistant can automatically prefill and configure a number of fields and sections in the Airbyte Connector Builder, drastically reducing setup time.
When starting a new connector, AI Assistant can automatically prefill and configure a number of fields and sections in the Airbyte Connector Builder
Connector Builder is a no-code tool that’s part of the Airbyte UI
